execute_js_code: execute JavaScript code in a browser tab session via TMWebDriver with timeout and session selection
find_session_by_url: find a browser tab session by URL pattern and return matching session ID and info
set_default_session: set the default browser session to use for subsequent JS execution by URL pattern
navigate_to_url: navigate the current browser tab to a specified URL using window.location.href
open_new_tab: open a new browser tab with a specified URL using GM_openInTab
